failure_summary.description: The agent returned a truth judgment, an explanatory biography, or a contextually related entity/source instead of the value requested by the clue.
The answer omitted the state qualifier included in the context’s conventional place name.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directs the agent to treat fragments as implicit questions, avoid true/false answers unless requested, follow the clue’s exact answer slot, ignore distractors, and retain necessary qualifiers. These failures reflect not applying those rules, and similar proposed additions were rejected in prior steps, so no edit is warranted.
